info.headline: Notify NYC - 2026 Alpha Win Big Apple Triathlon - 10/10
info.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 05:35 PM.
As part of the 2026 Alpha Win Big Apple Triathlon, there will be multiple rolling street closures in The Bronx & Manhattan on 10/10, at the discretion of the NYPD.
The following locations will be closed:
Manhattan: The Henry Hudson Parkway (northbound) between West 58th Street and the Henry Husdon Bridge West 96th Street between the Henry Hudson Parkway and Central Park West
The Bronx: The Henry Hudson Parkway (Northbound) between the Henry Hudson Bridge and Mosholu Parkway Mosholu Parkway (Eastbound) between the Henry Hudson Parkway and West Gun Hill Road
Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible. Use local mass transit if possible.
For more information, please visit: on.nyc.gov/traffic To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnRni5.
